subject: Request for semester extension and promotional top-up for OpenMind Lab pilot
messages:
From: Dr. Laila Hassan <lhassan@openmindlab.org>
To: nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: semester extension + promo top-up for OpenMind Lab pilot

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks again for the generous trial — the team at OpenMind Lab has been running a small-scale evaluation of your API for our courses and an ongoing research project on low-resource languages. We burned through the initial promo quicker than expected because we extended inference across multiple student groups.

We have two asks:
- Can Redwood extend the EDU trial window by 3 months (we'd like to run through end of July)?
- Can you approve a one-time promotional top-up of credits for our account (approx. $4k–$6k) to cover semester usage?

A few quick context points:
- Principal beneficiaries: OpenMind Lab (nonprofit research lab) + undergraduate NLP course at BayStarr University.
- Planned usage: model inference for anonymized transcripts + embedding generation for retrieval; estimate ~300k tokens/month for April–July.
- Data sensitivity: nothing PHI; some student identifiers that we will hash/anonymize prior to sending if required.
- We can provide a short letter on lab letterhead and our IRB reference if that helps.

I attached a one-page Statement of Research and a usage plan spreadsheet. Happy to hop on a 20–30 min call if needed. Appreciate any flexibility you can offer — this helps us keep the class running and evaluate Redwood for potential broader adoption.

Best,

Laila Hassan
Director, OpenMind Lab
[Attachment: OpenMind_statement_of_research.pdf]
[Attachment: OpenMind_usage_plan.xlsx]

From: nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai
To: Dr. Laila Hassan <lhassan@openmindlab.org>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: semester extension + promo top-up for OpenMind Lab pilot

Hi Laila — thanks for the note and the clear context. Really glad the class + research project are getting value.

Quick questions so I can fast-track this:
- Do you have an exact estimated spend target you want us to provision (you mentioned $4k–$6k; a single number helps finance).
- Will any raw student PII/grades be sent to the API (we're happy to accept hashed/anonymized inputs; if PHI or regulated data, we need to follow Private deployment controls).
- Would you be able to sign a short EDU acknowledgement (one paragraph) and confirm the research use case for our records?

I attached our EDU promo terms to this thread for transparency. I'll loop in Neha from EDU/partnerships for approvals and Marissa when we need final sign-off for anything beyond $3k. If you prefer, we can do a 20-minute call Monday to go over the usage sheet.

Proposed immediate next step: you share a specific requested credit amount and confirm the anonymization approach; I’ll open a formal promo request.

Thanks —
Nikhil Sharma
Enterprise & EDU Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_EDU_Promo_T&Cs.pdf]

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai, Dr. Laila Hassan <lhassan@openmindlab.org>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: semester extension + promo top-up for OpenMind Lab pilot

Hi all — looping Marissa in for approval on the promotional top-up. Summary: OpenMind Lab is a nonprofit academic lab running a semester-long evaluation; asks for a 3-month extension + ~$5k credit. They provided a usage plan and will anonymize student identifiers.

From a partnership/EDU standpoint I recommend a one-time $6,000 credit applied to their account with a 6-month expiry from the grant date. Conditions:
- Credits apply only to hosted API usage (not to Dedicated or Private licensing).
- Lab must acknowledge Redwood in project materials and provide a 6-week check-in post-pilot.
- We require confirmation that student data will be anonymized and that no regulated data types will be used.

Attachment: proposed_credit_note.pdf (standard note we send for EDU grants). If Marissa is comfortable with the amount/conditions, happy to draft the HubSpot note and apply credits.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Partnerships — EDU & Research
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: proposed_credit_note.pdf]

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, Dr. Laila Hassan <lhassan@openmindlab.org>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: semester extension + promo top-up for OpenMind Lab pilot

Thanks for the summary, Neha — approving as proposed.

Decision: Redwood will apply a one-time $6,000 promotional credit to account openmindlab. Terms: credits expire 2027-10-05; usable against hosted API invoicing only; cannot be transferred.

Conditions to be documented in HubSpot before credits are applied:
- OpenMind Lab will provide a one-paragraph acknowledgement for use in our EDU case studies.
- Confirm anonymization approach in writing (we have the usage_plan spreadsheet on file).
- Schedule a 30-min success check-in 6 weeks after credits are consumed or by 2027-06-20, whichever comes first.

I’ve asked billing to apply the credits and created the HubSpot deal note: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/XXXXXX/deal/DEAL-2027-1198.

Nikhil — please confirm once credits are live and share any DocuSign/acknowledgement link Laila needs to sign. Laila — thanks for considering Redwood for the class; happy to see this pilot move forward.

— Marissa Cole
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
[Credit applied: $6,000 — see console link: https://redwood-inference.app/console/accounts/openmindlab/credits]
